name: CX TimeFilter MCP Server
description: Provides time filter tools for CX Dashboard integration, allowing users to set predefined time periods, custom date ranges, and manage time-based filtering across dashboard tabs. Supports HTTP-based MCP protocol with optional authentication for seamless integration with MCP-compatible clients like Langflow.
